messages:
sophia: Quick check — SOC2 fieldwork kicks off next week. Need final confirmation on audit log retention scope for KMS/HSM access logs + infra/meta logs. Who's owning evidence for: (1) KMS access logs ingestion, (2) HSM attestation snapshot, (3) retention-policy alignment. Any blockers to pulling samples for auditors? cc @alex_k @chris_r @mike_ops

alex_k: I can own KMS ingest + sample export. Status: staging->prod pipeline exists but we discovered a March backfill gap. Tracking ticket ENGINF-2245. Need data-retention team's signoff to run backfill.

chris_r: HSM attestation: mike_ops is primary for vendor attestation docs, I can help produce the signed snapshot once vendor certs are available. Vendor request VEND-487 still pending.

mike_ops: I can take the attestation snapshot. Plan to run the attestation runbook tonight and capture logs. Note: vendor maintenance window Tue 09:00-11:00 PT — we should align if we need live access.

sophia: Thanks — for retention policy: is the policy doc updated to reflect 2-year retention ask? I thought Legal pushed a change last quarter.

alex_k: Policy link: https://go/docs/log-retention-v2. Two quick notes: (a) auditlogs bucket lifecycle currently set to 401 days, (b) evidence for control requires 2 years for this assessment. Cost approvals for extended retention are still open.

security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 fieldwork checklist item 3.2 (log retention evidence) due in 48h.

chris_r: For auditor samples I can produce NDJSON exports. Example curl to pull a small sample (redacted):

```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' "https://api.redwood-internal/logs?service=kms&since=2025-02-01&limit=500" > kms_sample.ndjson
# redact: jq 'del(.data.key_material)' kms_sample.ndjson > kms_sample_redacted.ndjson
```

chris_r: I'll run that against prod-readonly and drop the redacted sample in the secure share.

mike_ops: I'll confirm vendor window and then post the attestation snapshot (signed bundle + auditlog excerpt) to the secure share after the runbook. Will also link the run log here.

alex_k: Question — who can approve the retention cost bump? tagging @maria_finance for a quick decision so we can avoid last-minute delays.

maria_finance: Can approve up to $2k without extra committee. If the additional retention exceeds that, we need a short finance request (2 business days).

sophia: Action items (assignments):
- alex_k -> KMS ingest + backfill plan; update ENGINF-2245 with estimated bytes & cost by EOD.
- chris_r -> produce redacted NDJSON sample and upload to secure share (deadline: tomorrow noon).
- mike_ops -> run HSM attestation runbook during vendor window and post signed snapshot (deadline: Tue EOD).
- maria_finance -> sign off cost or confirm threshold by EOD.

Please confirm owners in this thread. If any blockers, call them out now so I can escalate before fieldwork. :thumbsup:

alex_k: Confirmed — I'll post backfill plan in ENGINF-2245 today and ping data-retention squad.

chris_r: Confirmed — will upload sample to secure share and post link here.

mike_ops: Confirmed — vendor window booked, will run tonight in staging and final in vendor window Tue.

maria_finance: Confirmed — will approve up to $2k. If estimate >$2k, tag me and I'll expedite the request.

sophia: Great — I'll update the audit tracker: https://go/audit/fieldwork/3821 and mark owners. Last ask: everyone please reply here with a one-line confirmation by EOD so auditors have a named owner list. Thanks! - s
